official UCI class attribute ('class: ckd, notckd'). Two rows in the raw data have a trailing tab character in the class value ('ckd\t'), stripped before comparison, no row's class assignment is altered by this cleaning, only whitespace. Unlike every other dataset in this study, the clinically 'positive' class (disease present) is the numerically larger one in this particular curated collection (62.5%), included deliberately: it is the only dataset in the expanded pool with natural minority prevalence above 50%.
